0.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LIMBETH_00718_LIMBETH_000_000
0.description: My apologies, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>, but I am only permitted to conduct business with a select list of clientele registered with the Boutique of Splendors.

1.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LIMBETH_00718_LIMBETH_000_001
1.description: Welcome, my <hex:020818E905FF0A64656172206C616479FF09676F6F642073697203>. Here at the Resplendent Tool Exchange, we offer the finest selection of tools available for the ever-discerning artisan. How may I be of service?

2.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LIMBETH_00718_SYSTEM_000_002
2.description: In order to obtain a resplendent tool, you must first use crafters' scrips to purchase resplendent material A from the material exchange.

3.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LIMBETH_00718_SYSTEM_000_003
3.description: Using 8th-level master recipes, this material can then be used to craft resplendent component A, which can be exchanged with Limbeth for a higher-grade material, resplendent material B.

4.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LIMBETH_00718_SYSTEM_000_004
4.description: The process is then repeated, crafting resplendent component B to exchange for resplendent material C. This material is then crafted into resplendent component C, which can be traded for the final resplendent material.

5.name: TEXT_REGNOR4LIMBETH_00718_SYSTEM_000_005
5.description: After acquiring a sufficient number of the final resplendent materials, they can be traded for a resplendent tool.
